## O11y FinOps recommendations
Resources whose percentile utilization over the FinOps lookback is below a **cold** threshold, from `O11yFinOpsFindings_CL`, with the recommended SKU and the estimated saving at retail pay-as-you-go prices. Current state is the latest daily run per resource (last 2 days); the time range drives the trend and the dropped-off list. Unpriced rows have no cost columns yet (see the pricing backlog).

parameters.name: Subscription
parameters.label: Subscription
parameters.query:
O11yFinOpsFindings_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize by Value = SubscriptionId
| order by Value asc

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.label: Resource type
parameters.query:
O11yFinOpsFindings_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize by Value = ResourceType
| order by Value asc

parameters.name: AssignmentGroup
parameters.label: Assignment group
parameters.query:
O11yFinOpsFindings_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize by Value = iff(isempty(AssignmentGroup), "(none)", AssignmentGroup)
| order by Value asc

parameters.name: CarId
parameters.label: Application (CarId)
parameters.query:
O11yFinOpsFindings_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize by Value = iff(isempty(CarId), "(none)", CarId)
| order by Value asc

parameters.name: Confidence
parameters.label: Confidence
parameters.query:
O11yFinOpsFindings_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize by Value = Confidence
| order by Value asc

content.query:
let latest = O11yFinOpsFindings_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(2d)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ResourceId
    | where "*" in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId in ({Subscription})
    | where "*" in ({ResourceType}) or ResourceType in ({ResourceType})
    | where "*" in ({AssignmentGroup}) or iff(isempty(AssignmentGroup), "(none)", AssignmentGroup) in ({AssignmentGroup})
    | where "*" in ({CarId}) or iff(isempty(CarId), "(none)", CarId) in ({CarId})
    | where "*" in ({Confidence}) or Confidence in ({Confidence});
latest
| summarize Saving = round(sum(EstimatedMonthlySaving), 0), Resources = count(),
    Unpriced = countif(isnull(EstimatedMonthlySaving)), MissingOwnership = countif(array_length(MissingTags) > 0),
    Currency = take_any(Currency)
| project Facts = pack_array(
    pack("Title", strcat("Est. monthly saving ", Currency), "Value", coalesce(Saving, 0.0)),
    pack("Title", "Resources with a recommendation", "Value", Resources),
    pack("Title", "Unpriced recommendations", "Value", Unpriced),
    pack("Title", "Missing ownership tags", "Value", MissingOwnership))
| mv-expand Facts
| project Title = tostring(Facts.Title), Value = todouble(Facts.Value)
content.title: Current recommendations

content.query:
let latest = O11yFinOpsFindings_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(2d)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ResourceId
    | where "*" in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId in ({Subscription})
    | where "*" in ({ResourceType}) or ResourceType in ({ResourceType})
    | where "*" in ({AssignmentGroup}) or iff(isempty(AssignmentGroup), "(none)", AssignmentGroup) in ({AssignmentGroup})
    | where "*" in ({CarId}) or iff(isempty(CarId), "(none)", CarId) in ({CarId})

latest

content.title: Estimated monthly saving by resource type

content.query:
let latest = O11yFinOpsFindings_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(2d)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ResourceId
    | where "*" in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId in ({Subscription})
    | where "*" in ({ResourceType}) or ResourceType in ({ResourceType})
    | where "*" in ({AssignmentGroup}) or iff(isempty(AssignmentGroup), "(none)", AssignmentGroup) in ({AssignmentGroup})
    | where "*" in ({CarId}) or iff(isempty(CarId), "(none)", CarId) in ({CarId})
    | where "*" in ({Confidence}) or Confidence in ({Confidence});
latest
| summarize Resources = count(), Saving = round(sum(EstimatedMonthlySaving), 0),
    Unpriced = countif(isnull(EstimatedMonthlySaving)), Owners = strcat_array(make_set(Owner, 10), ", ")
    by App = iff(isempty(CarId), "(none)", CarId), Team = iff(isempty(AssignmentGroup), "(none)", AssignmentGroup)
| order by Saving desc
content.title: By application and team

content.query:
let latest = O11yFinOpsFindings_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(2d)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ResourceId
    | where "*" in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId in ({Subscription})
    | where "*" in ({ResourceType}) or ResourceType in ({ResourceType})
    | where "*" in ({AssignmentGroup}) or iff(isempty(AssignmentGroup), "(none)", AssignmentGroup) in ({AssignmentGroup})
    | where "*" in ({CarId}) or iff(isempty(CarId), "(none)", CarId) in ({CarId})
    | where "*" in ({Confidence}) or Confidence in ({Confidence});
let first_seen = O11yFinOpsFindings_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated) by ResourceId;
latest
| join kind=leftouter first_seen on ResourceId
| extend SortKey = coalesce(EstimatedMonthlySaving, -1.0)
| order by SortKey desc
| project ResourceId, Type = tostring(split(ResourceType, "/")[-1]), Sku, RecommendedSku, Confidence, Saving = EstimatedMonthlySaving,
    Current = CurrentMonthlyCost, Projected = ProjectedMonthlyCost, Currency, Metric = MetricName,
    ObservedValue = round(ObservedValue, 2), Threshold, Unit, Percentile, DataCoverage = round(DataCoverage, 2),
    App = CarId, Team = AssignmentGroup, Owner, FirstSeen, Reason
content.title: Recommendations, largest saving first

content.query:
O11yFinOpsFindings_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where "*" in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId in ({Subscription})
    | where "*" in ({ResourceType}) or ResourceType in ({ResourceType})
    | where "*" in ({AssignmentGroup}) or iff(isempty(AssignmentGroup), "(none)", AssignmentGroup) in ({AssignmentGroup})
    | where "*" in ({CarId}) or iff(isempty(CarId), "(none)", CarId) in ({CarId})
    | where "*" in ({Confidence}) or Confidence in ({Confidence})
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, EstimatedMonthlySaving) by ResourceId, Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| summarize IdentifiedSaving = round(sum(EstimatedMonthlySaving), 0), Resources = count() by Day
| order by Day asc
content.title: Identified monthly saving per day (latest row per resource per day)

content.query:
O11yFinOpsFindings_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ResourceId
    | where "*" in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId in ({Subscription})
    | where "*" in ({ResourceType}) or ResourceType in ({ResourceType})
    | where "*" in ({AssignmentGroup}) or iff(isempty(AssignmentGroup), "(none)", AssignmentGroup) in ({AssignmentGroup})
    | where "*" in ({CarId}) or iff(isempty(CarId), "(none)", CarId) in ({CarId})
    | where "*" in ({Confidence}) or Confidence in ({Confidence})
| where TimeGenerated < ago(2d)
| project ResourceId, Type = tostring(split(ResourceType, "/")[-1]), LastRecommended = TimeGenerated, Sku, RecommendedSku,
    LastSaving = EstimatedMonthlySaving, Currency, App = CarId, Team = AssignmentGroup, Owner
| order by LastSaving desc
content.title: No longer recommended: resized, deleted, busier, excluded, or short of data (in the time range, not in the last 2 days)

content.query:
let latest = O11yFinOpsFindings_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(2d)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ResourceId
    | where "*" in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId in ({Subscription})
    | where "*" in ({ResourceType}) or ResourceType in ({ResourceType})
    | where "*" in ({AssignmentGroup}) or iff(isempty(AssignmentGroup), "(none)", AssignmentGroup) in ({AssignmentGroup})
    | where "*" in ({CarId}) or iff(isempty(CarId), "(none)", CarId) in ({CarId})
    | where "*" in ({Confidence}) or Confidence in ({Confidence});
latest
| where array_length(MissingTags) > 0
| project ResourceId, Type = tostring(split(ResourceType, "/")[-1]), MissingTags = strcat_array(MissingTags, ", "), Owner, AssignmentGroup, CarId,
    Saving = EstimatedMonthlySaving, Currency
| order by Saving desc
content.title: Missing ownership tags (cannot be routed to a team)
